## Text Formatting

This paragraph contains **bold text**, *italic text*, and ~~strikethrough text~~.

You can also use __alternative bold__ and _alternative italic_.

Inline `code` is also supported.

## Lists

### Unordered List

- First item
- Second item
- Third item
  - Nested item 1

- Fourth item

### Ordered List

1. First step
2. Second step
3. Third step

   2. Nested step 2
4. Fourth step

## Code Blocks

```javascript
function greet(name) {
  console.log(`Hello, ${name}!`);
}

greet('World');
```

```python
def greet(name):
    print(f"Hello, {name}!")

greet("World")
```

>
> And even contain multiple paragraphs.
